capabilities: Interpret selected English text from the Command Palette
Explain meaning, tone, context and intent of the selection
Show results in a dedicated interpretation panel
Configure Ollama endpoint, model and output language
disambiguation: Not a translation tool; it explains meaning, tone, context and intent of English text rather than translating it.
extras: Interpretation requires text of at least 5 characters; default model is gemma3:4b and default output language is Spanish; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get contextual explanations of English text — such as idioms, tone or intent — for readers who need help understanding it.
summary: AI plugin that interprets selected English text via a local Ollama LLM, explaining its meaning, tone, cultural context and writer intent in a panel.
